relevance_note: Single-patient case report of LCAT deficiency with two LCAT variants: "Genetic analysis identified compound heterozygosity in the LCAT gene".
method_note: Read the whole paper (text, references, supplementary CARE checklist, which has no patient data). One in-scope person, labelled 'patient' (rule 5). Relatives (father, mother, two brothers, a 20-year-old daughter) are described only as healthy or by cause of death and were not tested, so they were judged out of scope (neither tested nor affected). No parental testing reported, so inheritance is 'not reported'. Gly207Ser is said to be previously described in ref [3] in another patient; this is not a prior report of the same patient, so cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is null. The 'apolipoprotein A' reduction is recorded as a feature, but the checklist item 'low apolipoprotein a-i or a-ii' is left 'not reported' because the paper does not say which apolipoprotein A. Triglycerides (83 mg/dL), LDL cholesterol (88 mg/dL), haptoglobin, LDH, platelets, urea, creatinine and central corneal thickness are printed without interpretation and were not turned into features. Membranous glomerulonephritis (diagnosed at 21) is a clinical diagnosis without histology, so no renal-histology checklist item was set. Under D-27, normal findings (Ishihara normal, IOP normal, apo E normal, healthy optic discs, quiet anterior chamber) were recorded as the excluded abnormality; 'no evidence of hepatic or biliary disease' is recorded as written. The excluded Tangier features come from the Discussion sentence naming this case. No contradictions found. Built with a short Python script; all spans checked verbatim by script.
